title: A new type of deterministic Salem sets and its spectrality
summary: For all $0< s \le 1$, we provide a new deterministic construction of Cantor sets whose Fourier dimension and Hausdorff dimension are both equal to $s$. The construction is based on a straightforward Cantor-Moran construction with contraction ratios given by reciprocals of integers. The key tool to obtain the fast Fourier decay is due to the Weil bound in analytic number theory.
